info.name: getAllOrdersByPhone
info.description: Returns every order for one phone number, Newest orders come first. The phone is matched with or without a leading 0.

request.description:
Returns every order for one phone number. Newest orders come first. The phone is matched with or without a leading 0.

## Environment URLs

| Environment | Base URL |
| --- | --- |
| Production | [https://cashif.cc/payment-system/back-end/public/api/get-orders-by-phone/{{phone}}](https://cashif.cc/payment-system/back-end/public/api/get-orders-by-phone/%7B%7Bphone%7D%7D) |

## Path parameter

| Field | Type | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| phone | string | 0506445921 |

## Response status codes

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Orders retrieved successfully |
| 404 | No orders found for this phone number |
| 422 | A valid phone number is required |
| 500 | Failed to retrieve orders |
